jobs.occupation: Senior Engineer - AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling
jobs.description:
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands

Employment Type: Permanent
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer in AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling to join a small, highly technical R&D team in Amsterdam.

You will explore and build the next generation of AI-native developer experiences — from intelligent IDE capabilities and coding agents to context-aware, tool-using and self-verifying development workflows.

This is a highly hands-on role with significant technical ownership. You will turn emerging ideas in LLMs, coding agents and developer tooling into working prototypes, evaluate new architectures, and help shape future product direction.
What You'll Do

• Build working prototypes and technical demos for AI-native IDE and developer-tooling capabilities.

• Explore how modern coding agents handle context, tool use, planning, orchestration and verification.

• Design and prototype AI-assisted and agentic developer workflows that improve developer productivity and experience.

• Evaluate emerging IDE, LLM and agent architectures hands-on and translate findings into practical technical recommendations.

• Experiment with new approaches to context engineering, agent orchestration and coding-agent evaluation.

• Collaborate with universities, open-source communities, researchers and industry partners.

• Work closely with international R&D teams to influence technical direction and future product capabilities.

What We're Looking For

• Strong hands-on experience building IDE, developer-tooling or engineering-productivity features.

• Good understanding of IDE technologies such as IntelliJ Platform, PSI, LSP, or similar architectures.

• Practical experience with LLMs, coding agents, context engineering, agent orchestration, or evaluation.

• Strong software engineering skills and the ability to independently turn an early-stage idea into a working prototype.

• Strong engineering judgment and ability to evaluate emerging technologies beyond the proof-of-concept stage.

• Strong English communication skills and confidence working with international technical teams.

• Based in Amsterdam or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have

• Experience with compiler toolchains, build systems, runtimes, debugging, or developer test infrastructure.

• Contributions to developer tools, AI coding tools, research projects, or open-source communities.

• Experience building developer tooling for ecosystems with limited documentation, tooling, or training data.

• Experience with code intelligence, code completion, static analysis, refactoring, or program analysis.

• Strong technical communication skills and the ability to clearly explain and advocate for new technical ideas.

Why Join?

You'll work at the intersection of AI, IDEs and software engineering, exploring how the next generation of developers will build software with intelligent agents.

Rather than simply integrating existing AI APIs, you'll have the opportunity to experiment, prototype and influence how AI-native development environments are designed from the ground up.

The position is based in Amsterdam and offers a competitive compensation package within an international R&D environment.

jobs.occupation: PhD position in mechanisms of mixed neuropathologies in Alzheimer's disease
jobs.description:
Are you interested in studying the cellular pathways driving Alzheimer’s disease using human autopsy tissue and cell culture models? Come join our Neuropathology Research team and work together with experts in human brain tissue research and state-of-the- art disease modelling. Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common and currently incurable neurodegenerative disorder. It is characterized by the aggregation of tau and Aβ proteins in the brain. However, the neuropathological picture is often more complex than the aggregation of these two proteins alone. More than half of people with AD show additional aggregation of proteins associated with other neurodegenerative disorders, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and Parkinson’s disease. In this PhD project, you will investigate the mechanisms underlying the emergence of mixed neuropathologies in the brains of people with AD. You will work at the intersection of different neurodegenerative diseases and use human autopsy brain tissue, transcriptomics and induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-based cell culture models. Your research will contribute to identifying disease mechanisms in AD, with potential relevance to other neurodegenerative disorders. During this four-year PhD project, you will work closely with molecular neuroscientists, neuropathology experts and bioinformaticians Would you like to know more about the different phases within the PhD trajectory? You can read more about this on this page. You will investigate the biological mechanisms underlying mixed neuropathologies in Alzheimer’s disease. Your work combines human brain tissue research with advanced molecular and cellular models. You will: perform cutting-edge transcriptomic analyses; work with iPSC-based neural cultures and develop novel disease models; work with human autopsy brain tissue from people with Alzheimer’s disease, strengthening the translational impact of your research; study biological mechanisms in Alzheimer’s disease and

identify potential therapeutic targets. We are looking for a motivated researcher with an interest in neurodegenerative diseases and neuropathology. You have: a Master’s degree in neuroscience, biomedical sciences, biology or a related field; a demonstrable interest in neurodegenerative diseases and neuropathology; a strong background in wet-lab research; experience with cell culture is an advantage; strong analytical skills; experience with bioinformatics is an advantage; good oral and written communication skills in English. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A contract for 12 months, with the intention to extend for a total of four years. The Guideline PhD contract applies to this vacancy. Classification in salary scale OIO: € 3.217 to € 4.077 gross for full-time employment (depending on experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. If you travel by foot, bicycle, or car, a mileage allowance of €0.21 per km applies (up to a maximum of 40 km one way by car). Do you prefer walking or cycling? Take advantage of our good bike scheme. Pension accrual with BeFrank, a modern, comprehensible and fairly priced pension. The team consists of neuroscientists and neuropathologists working on research into neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer’s disease, frontotemporal dementia and ALS, as well as other brain disorders such as multiple sclerosis. jobs.occupation: PhD position in organoids for personalized antiviral testing
jobs.description:
This doctoral project will focus on developing patient-derived organotypic models to test and optimise broad-spectrum antiviral therapies. For rapid control of virus outbreaks, fast availability of antivirals is a major bottleneck. In DETECTIVE, innovative models will be used for setting up an antiviral testing pipeline without the need for animals models. This doctoral project will focus on developing patient-derived organotypic models to test and optimise broad-spectrum antiviral therapies. Organotypic models, such as human organoids, are miniaturised in vitro organ cultures that mimic the human tissue-specific context. In this project, gut organoid models co-cultured with immune cells will be used to determine antiviral efficacy of available broadly acting antiviral against a scala of outbreak viruses such as enteroviruses and West-Nile virus. Patient-specific responses to virus infections will be assessed with integrated -omics techniques, and patient-dependent responses to antiviral therapy will be used to develop personalized medicine regimens for the future. With this project we will set the stage for an innovative human antiviral testing pipeline for viral outbreaks. Would you like to know more about the different phases within the PhD trajectory? You can read more about this on this page. At the Amsterdam UMC, DETECTIVE is looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC) to work on Work Package 1. As DC6, your objectives are: To establish patient-derived gut organoid mucosa models To test a panel of broadly acting antiviral compounds in patient-derived gut mucosa organoid models To identify virus and host factors determining treatment response by transcriptomics and proteomics Master’s degree in biomedical sciences, infection, immunity or related fields. Experience working with mammalian cell culture, qPCR, and bioinformatics is preferred. Experience working with stem cells and organoids is desirable.  Posted on Sep 22, 2026 
Deploy detailed models of coupled ocean / sea ice processes, probe their turbulent interactions, compare with observations, and design parameterizations for global climate models. 
Job description 
The past decades have been associated with substantial losses of sea ice over both hemispheres. Existing climate models are currently unable to accurately forecast these changes, in part due to their imperfect representation of ocean and sea ice interactions at sub-grid scales. 
This project aims to improve our physical understanding of these fine-scale processes, including the melting and breakage of sea ice, using a framework consisting of an ocean Large Eddy Simulation (LES) and a Discrete Element Model (DEM) of sea ice. Results from these simulations will be validated against a combination of in-situ and remote sensing data from both the Arctic and Antarctic sea ice regions. Based on this new understanding, the candidate will develop parameterizations that can emulate these physics for use in more coarsely-resolved climate models. 
This fully-funded position is part of the European Research Council (ERC) 'ICE-FLOE' project, and will involve collaborations with other team members at TU Delft and internationally. There may also be the opportunity to assist with a research cruise in Antarctica. 
Job requirements - PhD in oceanography, cryospheric science, climate science, or atmospheric science. - Experience with Large Eddy Simulations, turbulence research, and the Julia programming language is an advantage but not required. - Interest in the intersection of solid/fluid mechanics. - Ability to work independently. - Excellent command of written and spoken English. - Ability to start the position in January-March 2027 (with some flexibility).

Projects run over budget or returns lag behind? This is often due to insufficient insight into the relationship between progress, costs and planning. With good cost control you can avoid financial surprises and make timely adjustments. What is cost control and why is it crucial? 
Cost control, or cost management, is the process of monitoring, analyzing and adjusting project costs against budget. It is closely related to cost management: the broader set of financial control within projects. 
Well-organized cost control makes project costs predictable, controllable and accountable to the client, management and board. Especially in technical or long-term projects, this is essential to maintain trust, both internally and externally. cost control 
 How does cost control work within project organizations? 
Effective cost control starts with a reasoned budget, but it doesn't stop there. Throughout the project, we continue to test continuously: - How far along are we really in implementation? - What have we spent so far? - How does this compare with the original budget and schedule? - Do we need to make adjustments, and if so, where and when? 
We set up processes and reports in such a way that you have real-time insight into these dynamics. Not explaining afterwards, but signaling beforehand. 
 Earned Value Management (EVM): measuring = knowing 
Earned Value Management (EVM) is a widely used methodology within cost control. It links three dimensions together: - Budget (planned value) - Actual cost - Progress/performance (earned value). 
By monitoring these integrally, you gain early insight into deviations and trends. Ditio applies EVM as part of a broader control framework, tailored to your organization, systems and projects.

jobs.description:
Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Barendrecht. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time options. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. Your shift starts in Barendrecht, where you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to the first customer on your schedule. At each address, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully, provide friendly service and collect empty crates when necessary. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next stop. Driving is only one part of your working day. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk between the vehicle and customers' homes and lift grocery crates. This makes the role a combination of driving, physical activity and customer contact. After completing your final delivery, you return to the location in Barendrecht and finish your shift. Frequently asked questions Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. You will receive training before working independently. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague and learn how a normal delivery route works in practice. What are the working hours?

There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Is Saturday availability required? Yes. You must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. You will regularly carry grocery crates and walk between the delivery van and customers' doors. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks throughout your shift. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Previous delivery experience is not required. Interested in working as a delivery driver in Barendrecht? Apply through Consolid for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the position, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

Join Albert Heijn Online in Amersfoort as a delivery driver. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time options. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The option to receive your salary weekly or every four weeks. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training before you start working independently. Support from an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amersfoort As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure online grocery orders reach customers in Amersfoort and the surrounding area. At the beginning of your shift, you check the route planned for you and prepare for departure. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to your first customer. At each stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully and provide friendly service. If the customer has empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Then it is time for the next address. This makes every shift a combination of driving and physical activity. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and carry grocery crates. At the same time, you have the freedom and responsibility of completing your route independently. Once all orders have been delivered, you return to the location in Amersfoort and complete your shift. Do I need previous experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. When you start, you will receive practical training and can join an experienced colleague during your first working days. This helps you become familiar with the job before

driving routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Is Saturday availability mandatory? Yes. You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. What does a typical shift involve? You drive between customers, deliver their grocery orders and provide friendly service at the door. The role also involves regular physical activity, including lifting grocery crates, walking to customers' homes and getting in and out of the delivery van throughout your shift. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amersfoort You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like an active driving job in Amersfoort? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.
